newsitem.title: USA: McDermott sees Q1 gain of $95 mln from sale.
newsitem.headline: McDermott sees Q1 gain of $95 mln from sale.

text.p: McDermott International Inc said Monday it expected to report an after-tax gain of about $95 million in its fiscal first quarter after selling its stake in an investment company.
McDermott said it had sold its 20-percent stake in Sakhalin Energy Investment Co Ltd for about $122 million.

"The amount includes the $110 million sales price, which the company announced on April 10, plus approximately $12 million in repayment of McDermott International's cash calls since January 1997 as a member of Sakhalin Energy," it said. McDermott, whose first quarter ends June 30, said it sold its stake to other members of the consortium, which holds licenses in the Piltun-Astokhskoye and Lunskoye fields, offshore Sakhalin Island, Russia.
McDermott is an energy services company.
